description: AIR NPE act 1 (chapters 1.1-1.5) played end to end by a real EVE client. A fresh character (account airenf, character Aira Enforcer) enters the AIR opening and the driver in air/air_npe.py plays each step through the client's own UI and services, as the client graphs ask for them, until the act 2 opportunity is accepted. Needs the client-agent patch, a server in tutorial mode (EVEJS_NEW_CHARACTER_EXPERIENCE_MODE=tutorial) and a fresh data root (the character is made on first launch).

setup.note: native character creation puts a new character into the AIR opening
each round plays tasks for up to 280 s; a stuck task raises after three plays
act 1 is done: the active task is in act 2
every task the client graph went through, in order

expect.note: the client never asked to leave the AIR NPE
